# Lazada Philippines

> Lazada Philippines is a leading Southeast Asian e-commerce marketplace offering electronics, fashion, beauty, baby care, and more with free shipping and daily deals.

Lazada Philippines operates as a multi-vendor marketplace platform connecting official brand stores and sellers with millions of shoppers across the Philippines. The platform features flash sales, promotional offers, and free shipping on a wide variety of product categories including electronics, baby care, telecommunications, and consumer goods.

## Shopping & Marketplace

- [Lazada Philippines Homepage](https://www.lazada.com.ph): Main Lazada Philippines portal featuring electronics, fashion, beauty, toys and daily deals with free shipping

## Official Brand Stores

- [Apple Flagship Store](https://www.lazada.com.ph/shop/apple-flagship): Apple Flagship Store official retailer on Lazada for authentic electronics and Apple products
- [Mamypoko Official Store](https://www.lazada.com.ph/shop/mamypoko): Mamypoko official store on Lazada for baby diapers and premium baby care products
- [DITO Telecommunity Official Store](https://www.lazada.com.ph/shop/dito-telecommunity): DITO Telecommunity official store offering telecommunications products and services

## Authorized Retailers

- [Deli PH Official Store](https://www.lazada.com.ph/shop/deli-ph): Deli PH authorized seller shop on Lazada Philippines marketplace
- [Greenfield Official Store](https://www.lazada.com.ph/shop/greenfield): Greenfield official store on Lazada Philippines e-commerce marketplace
